setup.title: Set up a provider
setup.intro: Some markets come from providers that Finora does not name in its code. Each one is described in a provider file in your data folder.
setup.step1: Open the provider file in your data folder (providers.json). Create it if it does not exist.
setup.step2: Add an entry for each provider code shown on the tile: {codes}.
setup.step3: Restart Finora, then choose Check again.
setup.private: The file stays on this machine. It is never committed or shared.

wiped.title: Value below peaks
wiped.sum: Sums the rows whose sources allow a value: {rows}. Peaks fall on different dates; the oldest figure is from {oldest}.
wiped.cryptoNote: Bitcoin and ether are part of the crypto total, not added again.
wiped.left: Left out for lack of a value: {rows}.

strip.title: Distance from peak
strip.basis: Each row's peak is the highest daily close in its window; the total crypto market uses its all-time high · sorted by drop
strip.basisSince: Each row's peak is the highest daily close since {since}, unless the row says otherwise · sorted by drop
strip.note: Each bar is a drop from that market's own peak; peaks fall on different dates. Arrows and signs carry the direction, not colour alone.
strip.failedCheck: Not shown: failed a data check
strip.table: Distance from peak, as a table

debt.caveat: The ticker is an estimate from the last 30 days' average change.

banner.stale: Some values are older than their usual refresh. The other tiles are current.
banner.failed: One source failed. Its rows show no number rather than one that may be out of date. The other tiles are current.
banner.failedLastGood: One source failed. Its rows show no current number; a last good value is marked with its time. The other tiles are current.

crash.notCovered: Not covered in v1: Europe, the Americas outside the US and South Korea (no free source).
crash.personalUse: Personal-use market series stay on this machine and are never exported or shared.

how.title: How it's calculated
how.body: Drawdown = the latest close ÷ the highest daily close in the window − 1. Every series is fetched by this machine without a key.
how.bodySince: Drawdown = the latest close ÷ the highest daily close since {since} − 1. Every series is fetched by this machine without a key.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Finora shows what public registers publish and what research agents find on the open web, with the source of every value. It is a research tool, not a credit report.
terms.blockedCredit: Credit decisions about a private individual or sole trader
terms.blockedEmployment: Employment decisions about a private individual or sole trader
terms.blockedInsurance: Insurance decisions about a private individual or sole trader
terms.blockedTenancy: Tenancy decisions about a private individual or sole trader
terms.blockedLicensing: Licensing decisions about a private individual or sole trader
terms.blockedServicing: Servicing or collecting credit about a private individual or sole trader
terms.purposeLine: Before details about the people of a company are shown, a purpose is asked for. The purpose is logged for each company opened.
terms.objectionLine: To object to a record about you, or to ask for it to be corrected or removed, use the report-a-problem form on that page.
terms.disclaimer: Not a credit report. Not for credit, employment, tenancy or insurance decisions.
terms.draft: These terms are a draft until a lawyer has reviewed them.
